issues: Lack of checks to prevent overpayment in 'makeSetupPayment' and 'makeMonthlyPayment' functions. Excess funds are not refunded to the client.
The contract does not handle scenarios where the contract end is reached and payments can no longer be made.
Contract does not clearly define what happens to the obligations after termination.
recommendations: Implement a mechanism to refund excess payments or revert excessive amounts sent in payments.
Consider functionality to prevent payments if the contract duration has expired, even if it's still in an active state until manually terminated.
Clarify the handling of obligations upon contract termination, potentially requiring a final status report on obligations.
